faq.q: What does a website cost in Switzerland?
faq.a: A website starts from 99 CHF per month and a webshop from 125 CHF per month. The monthly price covers design, hosting, maintenance and SEO foundations without a large one time invoice.
Yes. Hosting, technical updates and ongoing security are part of the monthly plan. There is no separate invoice for it.
The minimum term is 36 months, after that the plan is cancellable monthly. All prices are excl. VAT.

faq.q: What are web design prices in Switzerland?
faq.a: Classic Swiss agencies usually charge a four figure one off amount for an SME website, plus hosting and maintenance per year. At amai! you pay from 99 CHF per month instead and design, build, hosting and maintenance are included.

faq.q: What does a website cost per month in Switzerland?
faq.a: At amai! a website costs from 99 CHF per month, a webshop from 125 CHF per month, excl. VAT. Everything is included: design, build, hosting, maintenance and SEO basics. There is no deposit and no separate hosting invoice. The minimum term is 36 months.

price.seoTitle: Website prices Switzerland: what does a website cost?
price.seoBody: A professional website at amai! costs from 99 CHF per month, a webshop from 125 CHF per month, excl. VAT. That price covers design, technical build, hosting, maintenance and SEO basics. In Switzerland, web design prices for a comparable project quickly reach several thousand francs as a one off and hosting and maintenance come on top. We spread the same work across a monthly amount, so you know the website prices from the start and get no follow up invoice. The exact price is agreed upfront, as soon as the scope is clear.

home.moreText: Your website can become the starting point for marketing, automation and smarter business systems.

how.text: From the first idea to the finished website, we guide you personally, step by step. Design, build, hosting, maintenance and SEO are part of the subscription, so your business gets found online in Switzerland and stays visible for the long run.
how.metaDescription: How the amai! website subscription works: discovery call, digital signup, delivery within a few business days and ongoing support. Modern web design for SMEs in Switzerland.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.body: We get to know each other, you introduce your company and share your wishes, your goals and a moodboard if you have one. That way we understand what makes your brand yours and what matters most to you.

steps.title: Subscribe to the plan that fits your business
steps.chip: Start within a few working days
steps.body: Signing up is fully digital, simple and quick. As soon as your first payment arrives, we start on your design within a few working days. No waiting, no paperwork, you give the go ahead and we get moving.

steps.title: We turn your needs into a blueprint
steps.body: In a structured session and with a questionnaire we capture your wishes and requirements. From these we shape a clear blueprint. The build starts only after your approval. This way we work professionally and to a fixed method.

steps.title: We build your website
steps.body: Your dream website takes shape, modern, fast and mobile friendly. At fixed check ins we share progress, you give feedback and we adjust where needed. Depending on your plan, there is room for ongoing tweaks, so the result truly fits.

steps.title: We maintain and improve continuously
steps.body: After launch, we stay by your side. Updates, security and hosting are part of your subscription. Changes and new features happen flexibly, at the hourly rate of 95 CHF.

items.a: Yes. Your content and your domain name belong to you. Design and code are provided as part of the subscription; the exact handover terms are described in our subscription terms.
After the agreed notice period the subscription ends. We clarify the handover of domain and content in advance so there are no surprises.
Yes. Hosting, technical updates, basic security and ongoing maintenance are part of the subscription.
Yes. Changes after launch are billed transparently at the hourly rate of 95 CHF. Larger requests are estimated in advance.
Yes, you can move up to a higher plan whenever your needs grow.

SEO (search engine optimisation) helps your website get found more easily on Google. We set up the technical and content basics: structure, speed, meta tags and local foundations. Specific Google rankings cannot, however, be guaranteed.

items.q: Can you replace my existing website?
items.a: Yes. We build a new, modern website and handle the transition from your existing site cleanly.

items.q: Do you also build websites with login areas or customer portals?
items.a: Yes, through Software & Applications: customer portals, login areas, dashboards and custom workflows.

items.q: Do you work with Swiss companies?
items.a: Yes. amai! focuses on SMEs, self employed professionals and local companies in Switzerland.

items.q: Do you also offer a logo and brand guidelines?
items.a: Yes. On request we design a matching logo and a compact brand guide (colours, fonts, usage), a one time add-on in addition to your subscription. You can find the current price on the pricing page.
No. Websites are the starting point for many clients but amai! also helps with email marketing, marketing automation, booking systems, business systems and AI assistants.
Yes. We use AI in our build process, so we build faster and at a lower cost than traditional agencies. We also offer AI solutions like assistants and automations as part of our service.

items.q: Can I start with a website and add other services later?
items.a: Yes. This is often the best approach. You can start with a professional website and add email marketing, automation, booking or business systems when your company is ready.

Marketing automation means that repeated marketing tasks happen automatically. For example, a lead can receive a follow up email after filling in a form or a customer can receive an appointment reminder automatically.
A CRM is a system for managing leads, customers, communication and follow up. It helps you keep customer information in one clear place.
A customer portal is a private online environment where customers can log in, view information, upload documents, follow updates or access files.

items.q: Are AI assistants useful for small businesses?
items.a: Yes, when they solve a practical problem. AI assistants can help answer common questions, qualify leads, search documents or support your team with repetitive work.
GEO means Generative Engine Optimisation. It helps AI search systems understand your business, your services and your expertise so they can describe and recommend you more accurately.

about.title: Personal, not anonymous.
about.intro: amai! makes digital solutions predictable and simple for Swiss SMEs. From websites to customer portals and CRM through automations and AI, you get one clear partner on a monthly subscription that grows with your business.
about.nameText: amai! comes from the Antwerp dialect, rooted in Flemish. It is an exclamation of admiration, a spontaneous wow when something truly impresses. That is exactly the reaction your website should spark in your visitors. We build modern, fast and mobile sites with content that sells, stays in mind and turns visitors into customers. All in one clear subscription without a large upfront investment.
about.missionText: Many small businesses need a good website without the technical burden. We take care of design, build, hosting, maintenance, security and SEO foundations, so you can focus on your business. Because we work with AI, we build faster and at a lower cost than traditional agencies and offer AI solutions like assistants and automations as part of our service.
about.founderText: amai! is led by Tom de Vree and is based in Bern. We work personally with self employed people, local service providers and SMEs across Switzerland. You talk directly to the person who looks after your website.
